raw_capture.guest_memory_source: read-only shared guest-memory snapshot at physical address 0x0A24B000

cause_and_fix.cause: The Xenos fetch marks this tiled DXT resource as packed_mips, but the decoder read the base image from block row 0. For a 512x8 base level whose mip tail begins at level 0, the image is offset 16 texels along its short axis, or four 4x4 DXT block rows.
cause_and_fix.change: Retain the captured packed_mips flag and apply the level-0 packed offset when untiling supported tiled DXT and RGBA8 resources. Unsupported packed linear layouts still fail closed.

replay.method: Offscreen Vulkan 1.1 replay of the four captured retail draws, shaders, vertices, states, packed DXT texture, and Copy/Convert pass.
